job.purpose: W-POL-APPR1 full pull, part 2 of 3: hourly candles (8.5 days before close to close plus 1 h) for every development market of the approval and generic ballot universe not yet held; live events one batched request, older markets one historical request each.
job.heldout: W-POL-APPR1: events in the HELD-OUT third per POL_APPR1_CUTS.json and POL_APPR1_CUTS_A3.json (ALL_APPR also) are never requested; one read of the result after every part is complete

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal

job.notes: Request ids are unique across the parts (h_<ticker> historical, l_<event>_<k> live batch). Order: small series first, then KXAPRPOTUS newest first, then KX538APPROVE newest first. Markets already in the first W-POL-APPR1 pull are skipped. Windows as the first pull: close minus 8.5 days to close plus 3600 s, period_interval 60. Start with part 1; every part is needed for the converter's marker. Status is ready: Main sets active when copying to kalshi_pull_jobs.
